name: 14294-batchdecode-30ba3b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B -- ungated bf16 MoE, ~57 GB of weights.
parallelism: TP=8 on one node with moe-dense-tp-size 1. DP=1, EP=1, PP=1, DP attention off. ~7.5 GB of weights and 24 KiB of KV per token on each rank.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32. Warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1536 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: ~512 prompt tokens in (stdev 128, clamped 128-1024) and ~512 tokens out (stdev 64, clamped 256-768). temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so each request emits exactly the number of tokens its draw asked for.
purpose: A 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts chat assistant answering 32 concurrent single-turn requests of roughly 512 tokens across eight GPUs.
launch:
# Eight GPUs of one node serving an unquantized bf16 MoE at TP8, ~512 tokens in and ~512 out
# per request, 32 streams in flight.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tp-size: 8
moe-dense-tp-size: 1

# Prompts share no prefix, so the radix tree can only cost and never return a hit.
disable-radix-cache: true

# The engine's own derived values on an 80 GB card, written out so the run does not depend on a
# device-memory probe for its KV pool or its prefill chunk count.
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.83
